jobs.name: momentum_01_launch_clip_a
jobs.prompt: The folded royal blue cardstock assembly holds, then its outer panels fold inward one after another with springy mechanical momentum, each snapping shut and settling with a dampened overshoot, gold beads at the joints catching the rim light as they turn. The camera performs a slow sweeping crane arc, rising and moving left, keeping the structure centred. Hard key light from upper right stays fixed to the world; faint volumetric haze drifts slowly. Ends with the assembly closed and compact, the left third dark. No text, no logos, no people, no purple, no lens flare.

jobs.name: momentum_01_launch_clip_b
jobs.prompt: Macro on the gold bead joint where folded royal blue cardstock panels meet. The camera drifts slowly along the gold cable, tracking left to right, staying in razor-thin focus on the bead and cable while the blue panels slide past soft in the background. Refraction moves across the translucent panel edge as the angle changes. The move never stops or accelerates. Ends with the cable exiting frame right and empty dark space opening upper left. No text, no logos, no people, no purple, no lens flare.

jobs.name: momentum_05_launch_clip_a
jobs.prompt: Locked high wide shot of the museum plaza at night. Two fireworks rise symmetrically from behind the museum, one on each side, and burst at the same height, one electric blue and one white, trails falling slowly and fading as a translucent smoke plume begins to drift. A second symmetrical pair follows, lower. Tiny pedestrians and a car move naturally on the plaza below. Camera completely locked, no movement. Sky stays deep navy-black; only blue and white appear in the sky. Ends with trails fading into dark sky. No text, no logos, no faces, no red, gold, green or purple fireworks.

jobs.name: momentum_05_launch_clip_b
jobs.prompt: Locked high wide shot of the museum plaza at night with two fireworks already burst. Three more symmetrical pairs burst at staggered heights in electric blue and white, each opening fast then easing into a slow gravity-bound drift as it fades, smoke accumulating gently across the sky. Amber streetlights and the museum stay steady below. Camera completely locked. Only blue and white in the sky. Ends as the last trails dissolve. No text, no logos, no faces, no red, gold, green or purple fireworks.
